Spectrier

Ghost

Galar · Generation 8 · Legendary Pokémon

Spectrier is a Ghost-type Swift Horse Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2 m tall and weighs 44.5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (145), with a base stat total of 580.
